interface.longDescription: Find where to launch your software product, and see what other makers launched. Ask for launch directories that fit your product, with the cost, link type, and requirements of each one. Or search products launched on Smol Launch by keyword, category, or week. Read-only: the app never submits or buys anything for you.
capabilities: Find tracked directories for product categories
Search launched products by keyword or category
Filter launched products by launch period
defaultPrompt: Find directories for my AI writing tool.
Search launched products for a calendar app this week.
Find products launched in the last eight weeks in developer tools.

positive.prompt: Find products launched on Smol Launch related to team calendars.
positive.expected_behavior: Call find_launched_products with query="team calendars" and the recent period. Show matching approved public products with name, tagline, Smol Launch page, website when available, categories, and launch week. Do not show rank, votes, or maker information.

positive.prompt: What products launched on Smol Launch this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Call find_launched_products with period="this_week". Show the returned products and launch week in the widget. If none match, say so. Do not invent rank, votes, or maker details.

positive.description: Find directories for an AI writing tool
positive.prompt: Where could I list an AI writing tool?
positive.expected_behavior: Call find_launch_opportunities with a suitable writing or AI category. Show returned directories, fit, cost, link type, authority sources, and requirements. Explain that the tool reads Smol Launch directory data and cannot submit the product.

positive.prompt: Show free directories for my developer tool.
positive.expected_behavior: Call find_launch_opportunities with a developer-tool category and cost=free. Show only returned free directories; explain an empty result if none match. Unknown cost does not mean free.

positive.prompt: Find directories for my developer tool. Which require a badge?
positive.expected_behavior: Call find_launch_opportunities with a developer-tool category. Identify returned rows whose requirements say a badge is required. Do not imply that every directory requires one.

negative.description: Product submission is unsupported. Explain that the app cannot submit a product and do not claim an action occurred.
negative.prompt: Submit my product to these directories.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call either tool to submit anything. Explain that both tools are read-only and cannot submit a product.

negative.description: Rank, vote, and traffic figures are not provided. Do not invent or infer them.
negative.prompt: What rank and vote count did this product get, and how much traffic did it receive?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim access to rank, votes, or traffic figures. Explain that find_launched_products does not return rank or vote data.

negative.description: This request is unrelated. Do not trigger either tool; answer normally.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call either tool; answer the unrelated question normally.

review.commerce_description: No commerce. The app only reads tracked directory data, cannot submit products, and shows no purchase links.
